title: Superside vs an AI Video Ad Agency: Cost, Scope and Fit
summary: As of October 2026, Superside sells subscriptions from a $15,000 monthly minimum. Compare it with an AI video ad agency on scope, term and finished ads a week.
body_markdown:
## Which AI video ad agencies belong on the shortlist?


Creatify Studio is the managed option from Creatify, which also sells self-serve AI ad software. As of October 2026, its Studio page lists a 48-hour turnaround, 25 to 100 or more videos a month and a human review of every ad before it ships, and its comparison table puts Studio at $100 to $200 per video. Its[pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) lists the same volume and turnaround, plus human QA on every asset and a dedicated account manager, but gives no Studio price. Neither page says whether Studio runs campaigns, so ask.


Admiral Media sells AI UGC batches finished with human editing and quality review. Its[AI UGC page](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) lists a Starter batch at €10,000 for 20 ads of up to 15 seconds, a Growth batch at €16,000 for 40 ads of up to 30 seconds, and a Pro batch at €29,000 for 80 ads of up to 60 seconds. The page says its ideal clients invest US$50,000 or more a month in paid media, so a smaller budget may not fit that model.


Vidful sells three monthly plans. Its[homepage](https://vidful.co/) lists a 60-video entry plan for $3,495 a month, about $58 a video on our arithmetic, and says the entry plan ships 15 videos every week. Its production types are AI UGC, AI animation and edits of your existing footage. It targets DTC brands and ecommerce agencies spending $30,000 to $500,000 or more a month on ads. Ask whether it manages ad accounts, because the plan summary does not say.


## What Meta rules apply to AI video ads?


Meta's[transparency update](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) , updated June 1, 2026, says it labels ads created or significantly edited with its own generative AI features. When those tools add a photorealistic AI-generated person, the label appears next to the Sponsored label. Meta also says it will begin detecting ads made or edited with third-party AI tools and show an "AI info" label in About this ad. The post does not say that detection is live yet, and the experience can vary by region.


Plan for that label whichever provider you hire. Ask each one which tools produced each shot, and keep the production files that show it.


Meta's[Advantage+ creative page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/meta-advantage-plus/creative) says some enhancements may be on by default and can be turned off at any time. Ask each provider which enhancements are active on the ads it launches, because a default setting can change a video you already approved.


Volume matters too. Meta's[Andromeda engineering post](https://engineering.fb.com/2024/12/02/production-engineering/meta-andromeda-advantage-automation-next-gen-personalized-ads-retrieval-engine/) says the number of ad creatives in its recommendation systems is expected to grow significantly. Our[Andromeda creative guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/meta-andromeda-creative) explains what that means for testing. When you compare a subscription with a batch, ask for concept counts, not only file counts.


## How do you compare the two proposals fairly?


Give both providers the same brief: one product, one offer, the same script length and the same formats. Ask Superside how its flex budget would cover each video, including revisions and any motion work. Ask the AI video agency how many finished ads it would deliver in the first week, which presenters it would use, and who checks the claims in each script.


Then score what arrives, not the monthly fee alone. Count approved concepts, finished variants, revision rounds and delivery dates. Two proposals with the same monthly fee can produce very different numbers of approved ads, so count those.


Creative angles also differ. A short problem-first hook, a before-and-after demo or a comparison of options suits an AI video batch built around testing. A brand story spread across several product lines and formats suits a broader creative team that also produces decks and design work. Pick the route that matches the angles you need to ship each month.


If you already have a media buyer, a creative-only agreement is the cleanest comparison, and Knowlify offers it. Keep channel management out of the video comparison unless a provider has written it into scope. Knowlify does not run Google or TikTok ads, so those need a different provider.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for weekly Meta video ads: about 25 finished ads a week, a person checking every ad, and optional campaign management.
- As of October 2026, Superside's published pricing starts at a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term, plus a $1,000 monthly software fee. Ask whether that fee sits inside the minimum.
- Choose a broad creative subscription when decks, brand systems and web work share the queue with ads.
- Compare proposals on the same brief and count approved, finished ads, not the monthly fee alone.
- Ask every provider which tools made each shot and which Meta enhancements are on by default.


## FAQ


### What is the best alternative to Superside for Meta video ads?


Knowlify is our top pick for done-for-you AI video ads on Facebook and Instagram. It makes about 25 finished ads a week, a person checks every ad before delivery, and it can run the Meta campaigns or deliver creative only. Keep Superside in the comparison if decks, brand systems and other design work share the same queue.


### Does Superside cover performance ads or only design?


As of October 2026, Superside lists performance marketing creative among its solutions, described as a dedicated team that reads performance data and iterates on what converts. Its flex budget also covers video, motion and AI services. Confirm which formats and volumes a proposal includes before you assume the ad queue is covered.


### Is an AI video ad agency cheaper than Superside?


They sell different units, so compare scope instead of headline prices. Superside's published minimum is $15,000 a month on an annual term. Vidful's entry plan is $3,495 a month for 60 videos, and Admiral Media's Starter batch is €10,000 for 20 ads. Count approved, finished ads and contract length in each proposal.


### Does Knowlify run TikTok or Google ads?


No. Knowlify makes video ads for Facebook and Instagram and can run the Meta campaigns, but it does not run TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads. Hire a provider that manages those channels, and keep that work out of the video quote.


### Will Meta label AI-made video ads?


Meta labels ads it creates or significantly edits with its own generative AI tools when they add a photorealistic AI-generated person. It also says it will detect third-party AI-made ads and show an "AI info" label, but it does not say that detection is live yet. Ask your provider which tools made each shot.
